title: Webhooks
subtitle: HTTPS endpoints we POST to whenever a subscribed event fires. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 — your receiver verifies the X-Webhook-Signature header.
empty: No webhooks yet. Add one to start receiving real-time event notifications (orders, products, inventory).
testSentBody: Check your endpoint for the test delivery.
deleteConfirm: Delete the webhook to "{url}"? Pending deliveries will be cancelled.
rotateConfirm: Rotate the signing secret for "{url}"? The old secret will stop working immediately — update your receiver before confirming.

form.description: Your receiver will get an HTTPS POST with a JSON body whenever a subscribed event fires. Signed with HMAC-SHA256.
form.activeHint: Pause delivery without losing config. Deliveries stop immediately but the subscription stays editable.
form.urlScheme: URL must start with http:// or https://
form.eventsRequired: Pick at least one event to subscribe to

deliveries.title: Delivery history
deliveries.empty: No deliveries yet. They'll appear here as soon as a subscribed event fires.

secretDialog.title: Save your signing secret
secretDialog.description: This is the only time you'll see this secret. Store it in your receiver app — we can't show it again. If you lose it, rotate and update both sides.
secretDialog.acknowledge: I've copied the secret and stored it somewhere safe. I understand this dialog will not show it again.
